 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Shashank Shekhar, Adv.
 For the Respondent/s : Mr.Rita Verma, App
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Bibek Chaudhuri
 Oral Order

The instant revision is filed against the Judgment of reversal inasmuch as the order of conviction and sentence passed under Section 498A of the I.P.C. and Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act was set aside by the appellate court and the accused persons/opposite parties were acquitted of the charges.
Therefore, the instant revision shall be heard on notice.
2. The petitioner is directed to file requisites within one week from the date of this order for service of notice upon the opposite parties.
3. It is recorded that the State has already been served with the copy of the instant revisional application.
4. The instant revision be listed after service of notice.

(Bibek Chaudhuri, J) pravinkumar/-
